sources.entry: Cleaner for Xcode - Remove unwanted Xcode files. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/waylybaye/XcodeCleaner-SwiftUI) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A SwiftUI macOS app that cleans out unwanted and deprecated Xcode leftover files to free disk space.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes an app that removes leftover and deprecated files from Xcode developer folders to make Xcode faster and save disk space. It is presented as something to run weekly or monthly for upkeep. The README is in English with a Chinese translation of the description. It states the app is the SwiftUI rewrite of an earlier react-native-macos version called XcodeCleaner. It does not list the specific file categories it deletes. Build instructions are to open Cleaner4Xcode.xcodeproj in Xcode and press ⌘R.
use_cases: free up disk space used by Xcode
routine maintenance of the Xcode developer folder
build a macOS cleaner app from source
notable: Rewrite of the earlier react-native-macos XcodeCleaner
Available on the Mac App Store
caveats: Binaries may not be redistributed; the license forbids uploading the app or derived builds to app stores or other distribution channels
README does not list which files are removed or how much space is recovered
summary.license: Custom license: source may be used and modified, but compiled binaries may not be redistributed
